home.title: Type-safe messages, one chunk per locale and namespace
home.intro: Each page is one scenario, with the component and the catalog that drive it.
home.try: Switch the language in the header. With a chunk delay you can watch setLocale load the new chunks while the old text stays. Then whatever changed lights up.

plurals.title: Plurals and ordinals
plurals.intro: The same messages in ICU and in MessageFormat 2. Each locale has its own plural categories: Arabic uses six.

select.title: Select, typed per branch
select.intro: A branch’s params are required only with its key: card needs last4, cash needs nothing.

formatting.title: Numbers, currency, dates and units
formatting.intro: Values format through Intl in the current locale, so they all follow a switch.

richText.title: Rich text
richText.intro: Tags become React elements. A call passes a callback per tag, or leaves out the ones the config’s markup renders.

lazy.title: Lazy namespaces
lazy.intro: This page’s namespace loaded in the route loader, so the page never suspended. The panel below suspends in useParla instead.

fallbacks.title: Partial locales
fallbacks.intro: German is partial, Plodarisch, Sappada’s dialect, has only a few texts of its own, and Friulian lacks a few keys. Parla fills each missing key at build time, as its config says: Plodarisch from German first, then English; Friulian from Italian. Nothing is blank and nothing throws.

typedProps.title: Typed props
typedProps.intro: Each child takes the Translations of one namespace. The parent loads two, and its wider t fits both.

sharedPackage.title: A namespace from a shared package
sharedPackage.intro: packages/ui owns and builds common. The app imports that namespace object like one of its own.

typeErrors.title: Type errors Parla catches
typeErrors.intro: Each error is real: tsc checks this file, and a @ts-expect-error fails if its error goes away.
